answer: Assign each new key one open pothole ticket in a randomized wander/ridge/river grid cell. The claimant submits a timestamped photo with the ticket nonce; an independent road crew signs the repair or confirms the defect, and the registry consumes that ticket ID, rejecting duplicate coordinates, stale photos or missing crew signatures. Proposed field-audit fee is .40 per identity, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .40 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,400 (1,000 × .40). Limitation: open defects are scarce and crews can collude.
